intro: The Amethyst Phial is a delicate ceremonial vessel entrusted to young night elf adventurers by Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar. It is crafted specifically to gather and preserve sacred waters from the premier moonwell beneath the Oracle Tree.

p: Entrusted to initiates on Teldrassil, the Amethyst Phial is the final vessel used in the Crown of the Earth pilgrimage. Corithras Moonrage tasks travelers with carrying it to the far northwestern reaches of the boughs, nestled within the Oracle Glade. There, beneath the ancient canopy of the Oracle Tree, lies the island's first and most potent moonwell. The phial is carefully dipped into these radiant waters to draw out the essence of Elune's grace, allowing druids and priestesses to study and tend to the unpredictable growth of the World Tree.
